Title: Azure Maps iOS SDK is now in public preview

Body.Content:
The Azure Maps iOS SDK is now in preview with key updates that are aligned with the core feature set in Azure Maps SDK family. Some of the key improvements added to this update include: 

  • Consistent developer experience. 
  • Align with Android SDK and support Data-driven style expressions and Vector tile. 
  • Additional rendering layers. 

To get started with Azure Maps and Azure Maps iOS SDK, please go to the Azure Maps documentation and start to build your first iOS app. If you don’t have an Azure Maps account, sign up now for free. 

Check out the latest blog to learn more: Announcing public preview of Azure Maps iOS SDK.
